items.title: Junior Configuration Specialist
items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1000 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association . In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification . EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Junior Configuration Specialist engineer to join our team in Lviv! About the job: The Junior Configuration Specialist is responsible for supporting system configuration, client onboarding, incident resolution, and technical documentation. The role involves working with existing configurations, setting up client-specific features, testing workflows, and collaborating with Support and other technical teams to ensure reliable system operation. What You'll get to do: Support the investigation and resolution of technical incidents escalated by Customer Support. Analyze issues, identify potential root causes, and apply established troubleshooting approaches. Modify existing system configurations and set up new configurations based on business and client requirements. Configure client-specific features and rules using internal no-code tools. Support new client integrations and system setup. Test configurations and workflows in staging and production environments before and after releases. Follow established processes, configuration standards, and project-specific requirements. Document configuration changes, troubleshooting steps, and incident resolutions. Collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, QA, and other teams to resolve issues and support client needs. Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement of configuration processes and documentation. What You need to know: Basic understanding of software systems, configurations, and technical troubleshooting. Familiarity with web applications and client-server concepts. Basic understanding of APIs, HTTP, JSON, and system integrations is a plus. Analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and a structured approach to working with configurations. Ability to follow established processes and technical guidelines. Good documentation and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with Customer Support and cross-functional teams. Willingness to learn new tools, systems, and technical concepts. Previous experience in technical support, QA, configuration, or a similar role is a plus. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required; 30 medical leave days with medical allowance Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment with an 80/20 office/home format. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and a budget for external training. Gym allowance. Corporate English lessons. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include on-site massages and frequent team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!

items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a pre-sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems. Responsibilities: Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns You may be a good fit if you have: 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager Native or fluent French speaker (C1 or above) Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Working Student Software Engineer (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Corporate Services Revenue team is the backbone of financial automation at Raisin. We design, build, and operate the systems that power invoicing, partner compensation, and IFRS-compliant revenue recognition across all three Raisin entities (EU, UK, US) and the Cash Solutions business of Raisin Bank (ATM/CDM). Our platform ensures that every euro Raisin earns, pays, or records is calculated accurately, posted compliantly, and fully traceable — all with minimal manual intervention. We work at the intersection of data engineering, financial operations, and cloud-native software development, using technologies like Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, AWS (Lambda, S3, EKS), and NetSuite. Our small, cross-functional team collaborates closely with Finance, Controlling, and Product to deliver scalable solutions that meet both engineering standards and regulatory requirements. Your Responsibilities Support the development and maintenance of data pipelines (Airflow DAGs, Lambdas) that drive invoicing, compensation, and revenue recognition workflows. Write and optimize SQL queries in Snowflake to support data transformations, validations, and reporting. Contribute to technical documentation — including runbooks, knowledge base articles, and system design documents in Confluence. Design, build, and iterate on AI-powered skills and automations using Cursor to enhance developer. productivity, streamline workflows, and bring intelligent tooling into the team's day-to-day engineering practices. Your Profile Qualifications Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Business Informatics, or a related field. Available to work 20 hours per week alongside studies. Located in or willing to work from Berlin. Knowledge Solid understanding of Python programming fundamentals. Familiarity with SQL and working with relational or analytical databases. Basic understanding of data pipelines and ETL concepts (extract, transform, load). Awareness of cloud platforms (ideally AWS) is a plus. Prior coursework or personal projects involving data processing, automation, or backend development. Ability to work independently while being proactive in asking for guidance. Interest in or exposure to financial processes (billing, invoicing, accounting) is a plus. Curiosity about AI/LLM-powered workflows and a willingness to experiment with new tools to improve engineering efficiency. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from Employee Development Budget of €400 and one full training day per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 20 vacation days per year. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. You're fluent in AI-assisted development and use it with judgment, validating the outputs it produces. items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1000 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association . In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification . EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated DevOps engineer join our team in Lviv! What You'll get to do: You will be responsible for resolving issues with Linux or Windows hosts, analyzing logs and investigating any potential application/system misconfiguration. Working closely with other DevOps, you will be involved in improving existing and creating new CI-CD configurations, Ansible playbooks and Terraform modules to provide better and faster deployment of applications and rollout of new environments. Linux/Windows VM administration and maintenance, updating packages with IAC, debugging issues CI/CD pipeline analysis, maintenance and updates Dockerfiles optimization and improvements, migration of public images to a private registry Monitoring, analyzing and optimizing dashboards, creating a new one if needed and providing feedback to Dev/OP team Investigation of any reported/potential issues using ES service Support of infrastructure/application deployments and new releases Capacity management and analysis of effective resource usage by application and infrastructure Migration of existing Windows .NET applications to k8s Incident and Operations team support with their issues What You need to know: Strong Linux administration and debugging skills - Confident command line administration, filesystem management, networking, process monitoring, SSH, shell and system troubleshooting(Ubuntu/RHEL preferably) Scripting - solid proficiency with bash, Python, or any additional, for shell automation or custom tooling creation Containerization - Understanding of Docker, Dockerfile and similar technologies; daily proficiency with lifecycle management CI-CD - Designing, configuring and maintaining pipelines with GitLab(preferably)/Github, CircleCI, ArgoCD or any other, optimization experience will be a plus Cloud Platform - practical experience with at least one major cloud provider(GCP preferably) IAC - practical experience with Terraform/Cloudformation/ArgoCD or any other IAC tools, advanced usage with modular scripts will be a plus Automation - practical experience with automation tools like Ansible(preferably)/Puppet/Saltstuck, on advanced level with playbooks and role optimization Monitoring tools - experience with Observability stacks like Nagios/Promethes/Grafana/Coralogic or any similar one, with practical usage, dashboard/alerts and custom check creation ES(preferred)/Loki stack working proficiency or strong experience with any similar tools Kubernetes - proficiency with Kubectl(or alternative cli for k8s); solid understanding of deployment processes(clustering/deployments/scaling/manifests) At least 2 year of working experience as a DevOps engineer or 3-4 as a System/Network administrator Nice to have: Message brokers - any experience with Redis/Rabbitmq/Kafka Helm - as kubetnetes package and deployment manager Networking - Practical knowledge of base network technologies (TCP/IP stack, DNS, VPN, PKI/TLS, Firewalls) LoadBalancing - Proficiency with any of load balancing tools Haproxy(preferable)/Traefic/Istio/Envoy Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required; 30 medical leave days with medical allowance Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment with 80/20 office/home format. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and a budget for external training. Gym allowance. Corporate English lessons. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include on-site massages and frequent team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!

items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer with expertise in automation and continuous integration to join our Gaming Experience Team based in our Stockholm Office. This 10–15 person cross-functional team, including frontend developers, backend developers and QA Engineers, focuses on delivering customer-facing features improving gaming experience, making it easier for users to find games that they are interested in. In this role, you will play a critical part in building, maintaining, and scaling our automated test frameworks. Following our recent major casino platform enhancements, you will take ownership of quality assurance across our next-generation product roadmap—focusing on navigational flows, search performance, and custom player engagement and retention tools. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to drive end-to-end testing efficiency, maintain robust CI pipelines, and establish quality standards across our platform. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable automated test suites for web and mobile platforms. - Integrating automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. - Collaborating closely with Frontend and Backend Engineers to support seamless API integrations and optimize gaming platform performance. - Defining test strategies, coverage plans, and automation frameworks using Playwright and BDD concepts. - Performing API testing, debugging, and continuous validation using tools like Postman. - Acting as a quality champion within the team—mentoring colleagues and elevating automated testing practices. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - Experience with mobile app and Web testing. - 5+ years of experience in QA engineering with a primary focus on test automation. - Hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript for automation framework development. - Proven proficiency with browser automation frameworks such as Playwright. - Strong experience in API testing (Postman, REST APIs) and BDD concepts (Cucumber). - Practical experience integrating automated test execution into GitHub Actions or similar CI workflows. NICE TO HAVES - Experience with mobile app automation (Appium for iOS and Android) - Prior experience in iGaming, Fintech, or high-traffic consumer web environments. - Familiarity with additional automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Java or JavaScript with Karate or REST Assured). WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - 30 annual vacation days - Occupational Pension - 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually - Parental Leave Top-Up - Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner - 1,500 SEK equipment allowance - Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Our AI team builds the models, agents, and platforms behind Robinhood's products and the tools our employees use every day. We work in small groups where product, engineering, and research sit together and ship in weeks, not quarters. We partner closely with design, data science, legal, and compliance, because financial products need to be useful and safe. We value clear writing, direct feedback, and decisions backed by data. It's an exciting time to join us! As a Staff Product Manager, AI, you will set the product direction for a core AI area, from the first problem statement through launch and measurement. You will decide which problems are worth solving, write clear specs, and define how we know a model or agent is working, including quality, speed, cost, and safety. Every day, you will work with engineers, researchers, designers, and data scientists to turn early prototypes into products customers trust. You will also coach other product managers and raise the bar on how the team plans and evaluates AI work. We can't wait to see what you build! This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own the strategy and roadmap for an AI product area, and explain the plan clearly to senior leaders in writing and in person Turn open-ended problems into specs with goals, success metrics, and launch criteria Define how AI features are evaluated, including accuracy, response time, cost per request, and safety, and work with engineers and researchers to improve each one Ship in small steps with engineering, design, and data science, and learn from how customers use each release Partner with legal, compliance, and security so AI features meet financial regulations and Robinhood's standards Track product metrics and run experiments, then use the results to decide what to build, change, or stop Mentor other product managers and help set shared standards for AI product work What you bring 8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years shipping AI or machine learning products, such as features built on large language models, agents, recommendations, or ML platforms A track record of taking a product from idea to launch and growing its use, with results you can describe in numbers Working knowledge of how large language models are built, evaluated, and deployed, and the ability to discuss tradeoffs with engineers and researchers Strong written communication, including explaining technical choices to people outside engineering Comfort with data, including SQL or a similar tool, experiment design, and metric definition Experience leading work across several teams without direct authority Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience Nice to have: Experience in fintech, brokerage, payments, or another regulated industry Experience building AI agents or internal AI platforms What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! items.description: About the Team Regulatory & Privacy Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO), part of OpenAI’s broader User Operations organization. We build and run the operational programs that protect user rights and support OpenAI’s legal, regulatory & privacy obligations across its products and developer tools. Our remit spans privacy, online safety, AI regulation, and intellectual property. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Privacy Operations Analyst to own and evolve our global Privacy Operations workstream from Dublin. This individual contributor role combines hands-on management of complex privacy matters with accountability for operational health, vendor quality, and program improvement. You will take end-to-end ownership of how privacy rights requests are received, assessed, routed, and resolved across a tiered operating model. You will partner closely with Privacy Legal, the Data Protection Officer’s office, Privacy Engineering, and operations teams to translate legal guidance into practical workflows and resolve issues that cross organizational boundaries. Beyond keeping operations healthy, you will set priorities and deliver improvements that reduce avoidable demand, strengthen controls, and enable safe automation. We are looking for someone who independently identifies problems, makes sound decisions with incomplete information, and carries work from diagnosis through implementation and measurable results. items.title: Head of Strategic Pursuits
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment. This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done. You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success. The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered. This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function. In this role you will - Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes. - Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each. - Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck. - Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs. - Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top. - Partner on global and strategic accounts. Work closely with regional leaders and account teams on our most important global accounts, bringing a consistent strategy across regions and product lines. - Build repeatable winning motions. Turn strategic deals into scalable playbooks, improve pricing and packaging, influence product priorities with evidence from the largest deals in the market, and ensure successful handoffs into deployment. - Raise the bar on deal craft across the org. Coach AEs and regional leaders on executive selling, business case development, and deal structuring so the whole Revenue organization gets better at winning big. - Be the CRO's partner on big bets. Bring a clear point of view on which deals to pursue, how to structure them, and when to walk away, and represent that view in leadership and executive forums. Requirements - 15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, strategic deals, or business development at technology companies, with a track record of leading and closing very large, complex, multi-year transactions. - Deep deal structuring experience. You have personally designed and negotiated creative commercial structures and know how to make the economics work for both sides while protecting the business. - Executive presence. You are credible with C-suite executives at the largest enterprises in the world and can hold the room alongside our CRO and CEO. - Comfort outside the playbook. You thrive in deals that don't follow a standard process, and you know when to break the playbook and when to rely on it. - Cross-functional orchestration. You can rally Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and executives around a deal when none of them report to you, and you do it by being prepared, decisive, and easy to work with. - Business case and value fluency. You can build a credible, quantified business case tied to customer outcomes and defend it to a CFO. - Strong commercial judgment. You understand pricing, margin, and long-term account economics, and you know the difference between a big deal and a good deal. - Technical fluency. You understand AI and platform products well enough to shape solution design and hold your own with a customer's CTO. - Operator mentality. You care about what happens after signature, and you make sure what we sold gets deployed successfully. - Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable leading pursuits with teams and customers across AMER, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and India. - Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 40% of the time, often with customers' and ElevenLabs' executives. Bonus points - Experience building or leading a strategic pursuits, strategic deals, or global accounts function at a high-growth AI, cloud, or enterprise software company. - Experience selling AI, voice, conversational AI, or platform/API products to large enterprises. - Experience structuring partnerships, marketplace, or co-sell agreements alongside direct deals. - Experience in a company where the product and the market move weekly and deals have to keep up. Location This is a remote global role within the Revenue organization. You will travel up to 50% for customer and executive meetings and for working sessions with regional sales leadership. motions and industry best practices based on vertical nuances Continuously evaluate market opportunities, competitive positioning, and whitespace within target segments Cross-functional leadership We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. As a Research Engineer on the RL Systems team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. Orchestral is the system our researchers rely on to run training and evaluation at scale — from the rollout engine that powers agentic workflows to the infrastructure that keeps their workloads running reliably. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on. Your work will span the platform's core: the library, tooling, abstractions and rollout engine — including new capabilities like long-running tasks, subagents and RL features — and the machinery that runs data and jobs at scale, with a focus on resiliency, routing and request handling. You will own significant pieces end to end, from design to production. This is a software engineering role rather than an ML or infrastructure-operations one: RL or PyTorch experience is not required, and you will spend your time building the platform, not operating it. You will be building a distributed RL system, with the scientists as your users. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models. - Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long-running tasks and subagents. - Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale. - Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling. - Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling. - Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation. - Contribute to open-source rollout-engine and agent-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform. NICE-TO-HAVES - Hands-on experience with Ray or similar distributed-computing frameworks. - Open-source contributions, especially to rollout-engine or agent-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL. - Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments. You’ll set category strategy, run our most complex and highest-stakes technology negotiations, and become a trusted commercial partner to engineering, research and infrastructure leaders. You’ll put the structure in place so these buys scale with both speed and control, and as the function grows, you’ll hire and lead a small team of specialists and analysts. RESPONSIBILITIES: OWN THE ENGINEERING AND R&D CATEGORIES - Own end-to-end strategic sourcing for Cohere’s engineering and R&D spend: technology licensing, OEM partnerships, engineering and IT software, developer and infrastructure tooling, and engineering staff augmentation and services. - Build and execute multi-year category strategies grounded in spend analysis, market intelligence, and demand forecasts built with Engineering, Research and FP&A. - Over time, extend the remit into compute (GPU capacity, cloud commitments, data center and colocation), partnering with Infrastructure, Finance and Legal on some of the largest commitments in the company. SCALE SOFTWARE AND ENG-RELATED SERVICES BUYING - Run RFx, benchmarking and negotiations for engineering and IT software, from early-stage tools to enterprise platforms, balancing engineering velocity with cost, risk and vendor consolidation. - Own the renewal pipeline: anticipate renewals, right-size licenses based on usage data, and drive multi-year and commitment strategies. - Build Cohere’s engineering staff augmentation program: preferred vendor panel, rate cards, SOW standards and guardrails for contractor classification and co-employment risk across countries. PARTNER, DELIVER VALUE AND KEEP US IN CONTROL - Be the go-to commercial partner for Engineering, Product & Research, Infrastructure, IT and Security leaders, brought in at planning stage rather than at signature. - Partner with Legal, Security/TPRM, FP&A and Accounting so every deal is compliant, budgeted, properly PO’d and correctly accounted for. - Deliver and report measurable value: savings, cost avoidance, improved terms and risk reduction. - Maintain audit-ready documentation and controls in line with Cohere’s procurement policy. - Use Omnea and AI tooling, including Cohere’s own North, to automate intake, spend analysis and negotiation preparation. - Create the playbooks for your categories and grow the team behind them: hire, coach and lead specialists and analysts as the function scales. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM You’ll join a senior team of DBAs and SREs responsible for the database platform that underpins many of Kraken’s most critical services. This group combines deep operational expertise with a platform mindset, designing systems that allow engineering teams to innovate quickly while maintaining strong guarantees around performance, security, and reliability. The team is entering an exciting phase of evolution as Kraken continues to expand globally. Over the next year, we are focused on strengthening our operational excellence, evolving our database environments to support significant future scale, and increasing automation and self-service so that database operations become more efficient, at scale. This is not a traditional “keep the lights on” DBA team. Our work centers on scaling distributed MariaDB environments, shaping reliable patterns for high-traffic systems, and transforming operational knowledge into automated, auditable workflows that uplift the entire engineering organization. It’s a collaborative, high-ownership environment where clarity, rigor, and continuous improvement are part of how we operate. If you enjoy building robust distributed systems and designing platforms that make engineering teams faster and safer by default, you’ll find a strong home here. THE OPPORTUNITY - Scale and tune high-throughput MariaDB clusters to support continued global expansion and new product initiatives. - Strengthen high-availability, disaster-recovery, and backup approaches through sound design and regularly validated procedures. - Reduce manual operational work by building automation, improving process consistency, and enabling safe, low-friction database workflows. - Improve observability and alert quality by championing meaningful metrics, reducing noise, and ensuring operational clarity across environments. - Enhance database security through robust access controls, disciplined patching and upgrade practices, and secure operational patterns. - Contribute to modern platform initiatives, including containerized environments, infrastructure-as-code workflows, and reproducible deployments. - Partner with service teams to drive better performance patterns, operational readiness, and database hygiene across the engineering organization. - Participate in our on-call rotations with a long-term focus on making on-call predictable, informed by high-quality signal and preventative engineering. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. Support on TA Operations projects where required - Keep our internal documentation up to date, working with detail and organization to ensure scalability and operational efficiency This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have: - 2+ years of professional work experience supporting a fast paced recruitment team - Experience scheduling a high volume of interviews, managing multiple calendars, and supporting a large volume of interviews with hiring managers and executive teams - Attention to detail coupled with the ability manage a high workload at a demanding pace - A team player "can-do" attitude and a proven track record of partnering with all functions and levels across an enterprise - All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. THE OPPORTUNITY Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own. This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life. - Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience. - Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers. - Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process. - Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp. - Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast. - Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response. - React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself. - Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea. - Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. - A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed. - A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction. - Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated. - A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it. - A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it. - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. - Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas. - A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. Each hyper scaler plans its marketing globally, and requires a dedicated regional counterpart who knows the EMEA market and can turn global programmes into activity that lands with customers regionally. As Partner Marketing Manager, Cloud Partners, EMEA, you'll be that counterpart. You'll own the EMEA end of our AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft relationships. You'll work closely with our global cloud partner marketing team and with EMEA partnerships, sales and marketing, to ensure that our joint GTM investments land with the customers and industries that matter most in EMEA. Your job is to make sure every major global cloud moment has a clear EMEA plan behind it, that regional co-marketing funding goes to regional business priorities, and that our cloud partners in the region always know how best to work with Anthropic. This is a chance to help build and shape EMEA partner marketing from the ground up, including how the function works. What you'll do Be the named regional marketing counterpart for AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft in EMEA, leading regional planning and directing investments with each partner Create the EMEA strategy for each major global cloud moment (re:Invent, Google Cloud Next, Ignite and similar) Build and run a short menu of repeatable regional formats per cloud, such as executive dinners, developer workshops and industry briefings, with a set number of slots each half Decide with partners and EMEA sales leaders where co-marketing funding goes, based on the regional segment plan and our focus accounts Lead the marketing side of topics where EMEA buyers set the agenda, such as data residency and sovereign cloud capability Work with partner sales teams on account-based campaigns for named enterprise accounts Track what each programme delivers in pipeline, influenced revenue and customer adoption, and report it back to partners and to Anthropic leadership Turn what works into repeatable playbooks other regions and partners can reuse You may be a good fit if you Care profoundly about AI being adopted safely and responsibly Have 10 years experience in B2B marketing, with hands-on experience marketing with or for AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Have run joint campaigns and events with a hyperscaler, and know how their partner funding, marketplace and co-sell programmes work Understand deeply the EMEA enterprise market, including how buying differs between EMEA regions Can hold a relationship with senior partner marketers and sales leaders, and say no to a request when it doesn't fit the plan Plan ahead, keep track of a lot of moving parts across time zones, and are comfortable building process where none exists yet Measure your work and change course when the numbers say so Strong candidates may also have Experience in AI, data or developer platforms Worked on cloud marketplace programmes Marketed to both technical audiences and executive buyers Logistics Location: London (at least 2 days/week in office) Travel: across EMEA for partner meetings and events, plus occasional trips to the US (roughly 30%) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. Annual Salary: £160,000 — £200,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. As a Research Engineer on the RL Systems team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. Orchestral is the system our researchers rely on to run training and evaluation at scale — from the rollout engine that powers agentic workflows to the infrastructure that keeps their workloads running reliably. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on. Your work will span the platform's core: the library, tooling, abstractions and rollout engine — including new capabilities like long-running tasks, subagents and RL features — and the machinery that runs data and jobs at scale, with a focus on resiliency, routing and request handling. You will own significant pieces end to end, from design to production. This is a software engineering role rather than an ML or infrastructure-operations one: RL or PyTorch experience is not required, and you will spend your time building the platform, not operating it. You will be building a distributed RL system, with the scientists as your users. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models. - Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long-running tasks and subagents. - Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale. - Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling. - Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling. - Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation. - Contribute to open-source rollout-engine and agent-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Experience directly building and debugging complex distributed systems at scale, with an emphasis on reliability and scalability. - Strong Python skills and solid software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD. - A builder mindset: you have constructed systems from the ground up, not just operated polished ones. - A track record in small teams running complex systems at scale — for example in finance, crypto or ad tech. - Self-starter, low-ego and collaborative, with a product mindset toward your users. - Curiosity about ML and RL — this experience is not required, but a desire to learn is. NICE-TO-HAVES - Hands-on experience with Ray or similar distributed-computing frameworks. - Open-source contributions, especially to rollout-engine or agent-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL. - Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Design team at Raisin brings together product designers and brand & marketing designers; we are united by our shared belief in the power of respect, creativity, and the purpose to give people financial peace of mind. We’ve built a place where empathy and innovation thrive, where integrity and high quality standards underpin our work. We love our diversity and use the strength of our perspectives to reach our goals. We build with heart to create solutions that empower users, shake up industries, and leave a lasting mark, all while working to make Raisin a leader in our field. Your Responsibilities Create desirable, usable digital products and features: Lead design activities to launch and improve features that help customers explore and manage their portfolio or products and services offered by Raisin - and confidently move from information to action - across app, web, and email. Proactively identify places where AI can simplify complex financial journeys. Lead rapid prototyping activities. Use generative and agentic tools to turn bold concepts into something people can try and share feedback on. Co-lead - with Product Managers and Engineers - larger end-to-end design discovery and delivery. Hold the bar on quality and ethical guardrails: Make quality a habit: validate quickly, and iterate. Use qualitative research, flow analytics, industry best practices, operational metrics, and security and compliance feedback to keep UX guardrails clear and real. Support final delivery - working side-by-side with engineering team to keep the final work true to its original design intent, and manifestation. Own design QA checks, and support implementation by contributing to-be-reviewed code (through agentic tools) for the small things that make the experience better. Run feedback loops so AI-generated work meets a high ethical and quality standard. Collaborate across functions: Team-up with product managers, engineers, and data specialists to design and ship high-quality experiences. Be proactive in the way you work together. Spar with other designers - within and outside your tribe - to review and ideate solutions you propose - in order to create consistency across different parts of the experience. Use your depth of knowledge of customer expectations, behaviors (with support of emerging AI capabilities) to work with product managers - in order to define strategic goals and critical hypotheses of what makes a highly desirable, usable, and trustworthy product. Partner with peers, engineers, and data specialists to experiment and to put in place the UX infrastructure for AI-driven features. Co-create products that are personal and highly secure. Tell a clear story. Explain your design intent, choices, and trade-offs to team and stakeholders. Ask for feedback, and give it clearly and openly. Turn technical and compliance requirements into usable experiences: Translate complex backend and platform capabilities, including AI/ML models and agentic logic, into interfaces that customers and internal teams can easily use. Surface compliance requirements, and use them to shape experiences that are robust and friendly at the same time. Contribute to a living design system: Adopt reusable, flexible UX patterns, and add new ones when needed, so we make micro-frontends look - and feel - cohesive. Work closely with the team responsible for the Raisin Design System, so components and patterns stay accessible, consistent and well documented across platforms. Help the live design system grow: contribute spec-to-code delivery of components and scalable UX patterns when they support the features, services, and experiences you are designing. Stay curious, and keep experimenting: Contribute to the evolving practices and principles of the overall Raisin Design team, by owning definition of specific design and validation approaches, tooling, workflows. Keep your craft fresh. Stay current on AI capabilities and on how design work changes when agents are in the loop, so Raisin’s design practice stays sharp. Your Profile 5+ years of experience in product design, ideally within fintech, digital brokerage, or other highly regulated, complex environments (e.g., healthtech, legaltech, or high-stakes SaaS) where designing for trust, long-term user decisions, and compliance is critical. Experience in complex e-commerce offerings may also be beneficial to help customers understand a faceted product offering and non-linear decision-making. A portfolio that shows strong product design experience in complex products and systems: user-centered methods, and real examples of AI/ML-driven features, agentic workflows, or conversational interfaces. Deep understanding of AI UX design paradigms, specifically how to design for system uncertainty, predictability, user trust, error prevention, and "human-in-the-loop" feedback mechanisms. Extensive experience in various user-driven validation techniques, including qualitative, quantitative, and analytics-based approaches Experienced with prototyping using Generative and Agentic tools to accelerate concept exploration and build high-fidelity work - for both discovery and delivery. Mastery of execution and delivery processes, including project management and resource allocation Confident facilitating cross-functional workshops and aligning engineering-heavy stakeholders, including business owners, product managers, developers, data scientists and AI/ML engineers Data-informed mindset, comfortable working with security, compliance, operational KPIs, and AI system metrics (such as model accuracy, latency, and user feedback loops) Mastery of storytelling techniques to engage stakeholders and users throughout the design process, including explaining complex AI logic or automated systems in simple, human terms Proactive, continuous learner who actively integrates AI-augmented workflows (e.g., for research synthesis, copywriting, ideation, delivery) to optimize personal design velocity and output Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Qualifications - 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems. - Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust. - Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets. - Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines. - Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability. - Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents. - A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.
